_comment: Hierarchical LP AllGather on the SINGLE-PLANE rail-optimized 256-GPU cluster (300 fine nodes -> 44 coarse: 32 host cells + 8 leaves + 4 spines), 2:1 leaf taper. Topology comes from teccl/topologies/topology-dsl-frontend/examples/rail_optimized_256gpu.topo (it replaces the stale RailOptimizedSpineLeaf class, which modeled a non-blocking leaf-spine tier); the path is relative to the repo root. Single-plane counterpart of rail_optimized_256gpu_dual_plane_hierarchical_allgather.json.
